verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for a SaaS remote-access and IT-management product, so the axis applies. The pack has no documented feature for exporting all of a user's data in open formats. A generic Web API and an audit log with API access are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not a self-service full-data export, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
